detail: claude plugin marketplace update twining-marketplace, then claude plugin update twining@twining-marketplace at user scope (1.11.3 → 1.13.0) AND at project scope (1.5.0 → 1.13.0). The project-scope entry is enabled by the checked-in .claude/settings.json enabledPlugins key and takes precedence over user scope — anyone who trusted this repo long ago may carry a similarly ancient project-scope pin; claude plugin list shows both. Next session spawns the 1.13.0 sh -lc bundled server → twining-mcp 2.0.0 against the version-2 config. Cached 1.13.0/.mcp.json verified to contain command: sh. Resolves warning 01KY0QQ1QEQGBZMW4HZ3S69474.
summary: Local plugin updated to 1.13.0 at BOTH scopes — resolves stale-plugin warning. Discovered: a project-scope install was silently pinned at 1.5.0 and would have overridden the user-scope update.
